We created the Akşam to bring the iconic Sabah shape into something more refined – sitting somewhere between a slipper and a loafer. It’s the same silhouette that’s become synonymous with our Turkish production, refined with an exceptionally soft, lightweight construction and designed to go with everything – a suit, a beat-up pair of jeans, fatigue pants, and more. Handcrafted in rich oiled suede, the Akşam has no rigid heel counter, giving it an easy, slipper-like feel from the first wear. A single layer buffalo leather outsole keeps it light and flexible underfoot, finished with a rubber heel pad for added durability. The Akşam, like all of our shoes, should fit snug and glove-like out of the box, and will mold to your feet and break in with just a few wears. If you’re between sizes, we recommend sizing down.
• Entirely handmade in Turkey
• Rich oiled suede, which gives it a very rich and dynamic tone
• Soft leather lining (no socks, no problem!)
• Water buffalo leather insole & midsole, forms to feet
• Flexible, single layer buffalo leather outsole
• Replaceable rubber heel for added durability
• Lightweight, packable, perfect for travel!

Straddling the half-world between super sharp and slouchy, our Games blazers are cut with ease to make sure they sit at the more relaxed end of the formal spectrum, and as such are cut slightly shorter and fuller in their silhouette than our traditional tailored jackets.
Our signature Mk. I Games Blazer draws inspiration from workwear as much as tailoring; a casual 3-roll-2 button jacket with a boxy silhouette, two patch and flap hip pockets with a patch chest pocket, a generous sleeve and unstructured body shape.

A timeless American icon, reimagined through an Italian lens.
For this special project, Yuketen founder Yuki Matsuda brought one of the brand’s most beloved silhouettes, the Blucher moccasin, to a historic factory in the foothills of Mount Sibillini, where skilled Italian artisans applied traditional moccasin construction with unmistakable finesse.
Crafted with an elongated profile and wrapped in Horween leather using Yuketen’s own famed pattern, the shoe offers a close fit. The insole, built from full vegetable-tanned leather, features a steel shank, memory foam, and arch support—shaping gradually to the foot for lasting comfort.
Finished with a removable leather ‘kiltie’, pinked details, metal eyelets, and strong cowhide laces, the upper rests on a robust camp sole made of rubber blended with cork, in homage to 1960s work boots.
